notes.title: Meet Infinite Challenges: Roguelike Mode Major Update IS OUT NOW！
notes.notes:
Hello, gamers!

In this update, we've introduced a new Roguelike challenge mode to the game. This mode offers a pure card-battle experience, perfect for players who simply want to enjoy the thrill of card battles. The roguelike mode will be regularly updated and is available for all players who own the base game.  


Let's check out what's new in this update:  

New Mode
Introducing a challenge mode that strips away the storyline, catering to players seeking a straightforward card battle experience. Once players complete the B-level dungeon tutorial, they can opt to continue with the story mode or dive into the challenge mode. (You can back to the entrance of B-area to enter this mode if you have compeleted the tutorial.)  By activating the challenge mode, players can easily jump into dungeon battles using the UI button in the top right corner.

Players can seamlessly switch between the story and challenge modes, unlocking all basic cards, treasures, heroes, and more through either mode. The challenge mode features 10 difficulty levels, each introducing unique mechanics. Advancing through one difficulty level unlocks the next. Additionally, progressing in the story mode automatically unlocks the corresponding challenge mode difficulty to keep the gameplay balanced.

Feature Enhancements
Players will now receive a special visual cue when the Flying Wings curse reaches its 4th count.
Memory fragment icons will now be visible on the maps of all story dungeons.

Linked cards and treasures will no longer randomly drop in the shop after completing an SSS dungeon but will instead be found in seal chests within any challenge dungeon after conquering an SSS dungeon.
Improvements have been made to display card tips correctly when selecting cards via Discover skills and the graveyard during battles.



 Enhanced the event transitions when switching card forms within dungeons.
 Tweaked the monster skill - Bash, increasing the action cost from 1 to 2.
 Implemented specific logic adjustments for Type-1's skill.
 Standardized the wording used in some skill descriptions.  

Bug Fixes

 Fixed the issue where the level of dual-form cards obtained after leveling up a card first was incorrect.
 Fixed the issue causing abnormal effects when using different hero cards in succession.
 Fixed the enlargement of cards obtained through Discover skills in the player's hand.
 Fixed the issue where certain skills would lose their counters when transitioning between turns.
 Fixed the issue that triggered conditions and text descriptions for Wild Breath for accuracy.
 Fixed the issue where the display discrepancy in Amplifier Element's skills, adjusting the text to reflect the actual effect.
 Fixed the issue where the aura of Amplifier Element failed to impact hero skill cards.

notes.title: Exciting Updates in the 1.2.5 Version of Looper Tactics
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for your support and appreciation. Today we are excited to introduce the latest update for Looper Tactics. We added some function to make your gameplay easier but also fixed some bugs. 

Here is the content in this update:

New Content
1.	Hero  and Hero  have official standing pictures. And also added a function of switching hero skin, which player can switch to the new skin or the original one according to their preference.
2.	Hero  added an alternate male demon skin, which can also be switched.

Optimization of Function
1.	Added “Double Speed” function in combat. Player can speed up their fight during combat.
2.	Added a “Multiple selection” option in the Fire Fairy event, where multiple cards can be selected and sell after check the option.
3.	If minions who will trigger skill after dealing damage will die after clashed with enemy minions, the skill will be triggered first and then die, for example LifeSteal.
4.	Now every time player sells a card, player will continue stay in the card selection menu instead of returning to the previous menu.
5.	The unlock guide of the selected card will pop up after click to the card in the gallery.
6.	The number of unlocked cards in the first form and second form will be statistically displayed separately in the gallery-card menu.
7.	After receiving hero skill, it will equip to the unlocked hero slot automatically.

Optimization of Stage
1.	Improved the visibility of hidden path in the Forest of Decay of S stage.
2.	Enhance the visibility of reminder for Memory Fragment in the SS Archive.

Bug Fixed
1.	Fixed an issue where curse treasure may be superimposed by constantly switching difficulty in the World in a Box.
2.	Fixed an issue where ranged minions may attack twice.
3.	Fixed an issue where there was a chance that the transformed minions would overlap when triggering illusion.
4.	Fixed an issue where 0 damage Stone will attack hero in specific situation.
5.	Fixed an issue where there is abnormal movement during the skill collaboration of Bloodlust minions, Great Dragon and *Dragon's Might III.
6.	Fixed an issue where an abnormality would occur after upgrading to Level 5 card shop and entering the Card Home.
7.	Fixed an issue where Flaming Bird’s model will overlap in place because of multiple revive by spiritual eye.
8.	Fixed an issue where specific effects may remain when switching card backpacks when enhancing cards.
9.	Improved the translation of texts.

We are continuing to develop more content, and if you encounter any issues during gameplay or have any suggestions or feedback, please don't hesitate to leave a message for us. We will promptly address any problems you encounter.

Once again, thank you for your support and appreciation. We will continue to work hard to meet your expectations and deliver an even better gaming experience.

notes.title: Exciting Updates in the 1.2.0 Version of Looper Tactics
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today, we are excited to bring you the 1.2.0 Version update for Looper Tactics. We added multiple functions system and a brand-new stage, and a series of functional optimizations. We really appreciate all feedbacks and suggestions from players to help us better optimize gameplay experience. 
 
Here is the content in this update:

New Gameplay Content
I.New System-Build Score, where player’s build score will be counted after clear the challenge stage.
II.New Event-Material Conversion, where players can convert excess materials to mindfire outside the World in a box.
III.New Event-Switch Card Form, where players can switch card form in the challenge stage.
IV.New Stage-World in a box II
1. In world in a box II, added 18 event cards.
2. Outside world in a box II, added unlock event for dragon hero. (This event will be unlocked in DLC version)

Optimization of Gameplay Content
I.Basic Function Enhancements
1. Rebuilt the underlying logic of Battle to give a better performance to the battle graphics.
2. Now the player will no longer be able to act if the enemy dies after the skill linkage ends.
3. Now enemy can end his turn faster.

II.Optimization of Stage

2. Now medium doll have an independent mark effect.

4. Now monster will no longer use summon spell when player’s field is full.
5. Optimized monster deck, and repair puppets and flying turret will no longer show up at the same time.
6. Optimized the issue of the buff column of cards on the battlefield boundary going out of bounds.

Bug Fixed

2. Fixed an issue when monster plays a card, the player’s treasure and card would be triggered.

notes.title: Exciting Updates in the 1.1.0 Version of Looper Tactics
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
Thank you for your support and appreciation. Today, we are excited to introduce the latest update for Looper Tactics. We have made comprehensive improvements to various aspects of the game, including its features and cards, and have also introduced some exciting new mechanics to enhance your gaming experience.

Here is the content in this update:

I. Basic Function Enhancements
1.	The card catalog now includes a filtering function that allows you to filter by the first and second forms of cards.
2.	When completing a challenge level with a score, the completion screen will display the total challenge score.
3.	The item backpack now displays the hero's attack, health, skill damage, and challenge score.
4.	Added animated indicators to the red dots when cards meet evolution conditions.
5.	Adjusted the position of certain main storyline event tiles to make them more noticeable.
6.	Optimized the sound that plays with text, making it less jarring.
7.	Enhanced the clarity of certain interface texts.
8.	Improved the translation of texts.

II. New Game Mechanics
1.	Hero Cards: These cards restore health, change your avatar, and grant a hero skill card each turn.
2.	Hero Skill Cards: Various hero skills can now be used in card form.

III. Optimization of E-level Dungeons and World in a Box.
1.	Adjusted the difficulty levels of various dungeons.
2.	Added a new event - "World Rules," which randomly appears at the start of a dungeon and offers the various choices.
3.	Added bosses: "Soul Dragon - Red/Purple/Green." They appear after defeating the second boss if you reach a certain challenge score.
4.	Added a strengthening option in the timed events on the second day, allowing you to restore 20 health when on the brink of death. All timed events now provide +8 health instead of +5.
5.	Added an option in the timed events on days 3/4/5, granting +10% monster attributes and +2 challenge score.
6.	Reduced the cost of upgrading the Level 4 card pool from 500 gold to 400 gold.
7.	Added a return path on the third layer of the World in a Box.
8.	Adjusted the quantity and content of events on the map.
9.	Removed redundant text from the scoring rules description outside of the E-level dungeons.
10.	Added "Cannot Save" text to the descriptions of E-level dungeons and the World in a Box.

IV. Bug Fixed
1.	Fixed an issue where triggering a discover effect when defeating a boss with multiple lives could lead to a game freeze.
2.	Fixed an issue where sound effect resources could become abnormal, causing battles to freeze under certain conditions.
3.	Fixed an issue where effects lasting for the current turn were not immediately cleared when a monster entered a new life.
4.	Fixed interface abnormalities when selecting the "Easy Mode" at the Altar.
5.	Fixed an issue where the exploration progress of the World in a Box remained at 0%.
6.	Fixed the issue where "Battle Banner of Purity" and "Shadow Mask" treasures were not dropping.
7.	Fixed an issue in E-level dungeons and the World in a Box where some welfare monsters did not award challenge scores.
8.	Standardized the card catalog upgrade attributes, resolving discrepancies in certain card attributes.
9.	Fixed the issue where repeatedly opening and closing the card backpack at the World Seal could result in stacking buffs.
10.	Fixed the incorrect pattern of the event level for recruiting the Strong Dragon.
11.	Fixed an issue where the "Corpse Transformation" skill only targeted demons.
12.	Fixed an issue where the Vice Demon Captain triggered its summoning effect twice when deployed (e.g., with the Battle Spirit Stone).
13.	Fixed an issue where using the "Roar" hero skill caused the boss to trigger it each turn.
14.	Fixed an issue where the "Coffin of the Dead" did not grant the "Unstable Bomb" card.
15.	Fixed attribute anomalies when upgrading the "Armored Guard."
16.	Updated the skill criteria for "Specter" to include "All."
17.	Fixed an issue where the epic skill "Invigoration" did not apply to heroes.
18.	Fixed an issue where the epic skill "Illusion" spawned a 2-cost "Flying eye" card.
19.	Corrected the frame colors of some buffs.
20.	Adjusted the size of some buff icons.

V. Battle Mechanic Enhancements
1.	Temporary skill effects now cause the target to play a size-changing animation and sound effect as a visual cue.
2.	"Sacrifice" now targets two random entities instead of one.
3.	"Perfect Sacrifice" now affects all allies.
4.	"Illusion" and "Destruction" now only affect minions with action power ≤ 4.
5.	Added descriptions like "Fast Casting" to training cards for clarity.
6.	Added color distinctions to the revived card faces of the "Flaming Bird."
7.	Provided color distinctions for several blessing spells to make them easier to differentiate.
8.	The "Megalithic Idol" boss skill now triggers only three times per combat phase.

VI. Skill Enhancements (Skills with names containing '*' refer to the second form of the card)
Demon Cards:
1.	"Demon Guard" now also grants a hero skill card with action power 1.
2.	"*Megademon" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.
3.	"Vampire" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.
4.	"*Vampire" now grants permanent lifesteal to all friendly minions after attacking, and ranged minions gain an additional permanent +4/+4.
5.	"*Armored Demon" now also grants this skill to a friendly demon.
6.	"*Giant Demon" redesigned: when destroy a minion, +3/+3 and draw a minion, and deal 50 ranged damage to friendly minions whenever a friendly minion is summoned.

Elf Cards:
1.	"Blessing of Toughness" now affects all allies.
2.	"Blessing of Nature" now adds +1 attack.
3.	"Parasitic Rout" now inherits 40% of the attributes of the summoner.
4.	"Guardian Idol" with no limit on turn triggers.
5.	"Megalithic Idol" redesigned: Guard, Shield, Death: Summon a stationary stone with Guard and Shield, inheriting 50% of the attributes.

Mech Cards:
1.	"*Light Doll" changed from +1 attack to +1/+1.
2.	"*Repair Doll" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.
3.	"*Kinetic Device" now triggers its activation effect.
4.	"Support Mecha" now grants a permanent buff when a minion is summoned, providing a uniform +1/+1 bonus.
5.	"*Support Mecha" reduced its cost from 2 to 1.
6.	"Recycler" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2 and now restores 3 health when triggered.
7.	"Mothership" now aligns the class of the bombs it summons with its own class.
8.	"*Mothership" redesigned: Ranged, whenever a friendly ranged minion attacks, it gains +2/+2 and +2 skill damage, and whenever an enemy minion dodges, it deals 5 damage to all enemies.

Elemental Cards:
1.	"*Energy Essence" reduced its cost from 2 to 1.
2.	"Sealed Amber" now also grants a permanent +1/+1.
3.	"*Sealed Amber" now also draws a spell card.
4.	"Elemental Power" now grants +1/+1 to both itself and the rightmost minion when activated.

Dragon Cards:
1.	"Drake" changed from triggering upon minion destruction to triggering upon attack.
2.	"*Drake" changed from +1 attack to +1/+1.
3.	"Great Dragon" changed from triggering upon minion destruction to triggering upon minion destruction and attack.
4.	"*Great Dragon" redesigned: When deployed, it grants +1/+1 to itself and discovers a hero skill card.
5.	"Raging Dragon" now activates after using a hero skill once, rather than twice.
6.	"Strong Dragon" changed to grant +1/+1 after each attack and move to the right each time.
7.	"Lair Guardian" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2, Enrage trigger altered to activate after taking damage, and when triggered, randomly grants a minion card in your hand +2/+2.
8.	"*Lair Guardian" changed from +1/+1 to +3/+3 and now restores 50% health to friendly guarding minions when triggered.
9.	"*Dragon Mother" redesigned: When deployed, it grants +2/+2 to all friendly dragons and activates their skills.

Neutral Cards:
1.	"*Soul Watcher" redesigned: Guard, All, after moving, randomly grants a friendly minion +1/+1, draws a spell card, and draws a minion card.
2.	"*Type-1" changed from +1/+1 to +3/+3.

Treasures:
1.	"Helm of Summoning" redesigned: Now, it grants a random hero skill card each turn.
2.	"Hero's Golden Ring" changed to provide +10 gold coins after taking damage.
3.	"Sun of Chaos" and "Moon of Chaos" changed from +1/+1 to +2/+2.

We are continuing to develop more content, and if you encounter any issues during gameplay or have any suggestions or feedback, please don't hesitate to leave a message for us. We will promptly address any problems you encounter.
Once again, thank you for your support and appreciation. We will continue to work hard to meet your expectations and deliver an even better gaming experience.

 Resolved an issue where using illusion skills could occasionally result in card duplication.
 For skills with "all" targets, environmental cards such as stones and trees are now also considered valid targets.
 Corrected the issue in level sss of the dungeon where the Soul Dragon was level 7 instead of 9.
 Enlarged certain buttons for improved clarity in display.
 Enhanced the descriptions of certain skills for better understanding.
